what_this_is: The Workshop row for the compose-thumbnails-from-layout-templates folder: a script the person's AI runs on the person's own computer to build thumbnail candidates from their frames.

payload.label: Build thumbnail candidates from my frames with layout templates (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Make thumbnail candidates for my video from real frames of my footage, laid out like proven thumbnails: my face, the thing, big words, arrows and tags
payload.description: Six layout templates read off strong reference thumbnails (a claim box across a split, a big face beside stacked words, a magnifier on a flaw, price tags on a flat backdrop, a held object with quoted words, a corner face with stroked words) compose 1280x720 candidates from the person's full-size frames and cut-outs: crops, punch-up, white sticker outlines with shadow, boxed or stroked words, curved arrows, price tags, a magnifier. Each candidate is one row of values in the person's settings row (which frame, face box, words, sizes, arrow ends); the font is the person's.

request.description: A JSON file on the person's computer holding the request, put where {request} is in the command: frames, cutouts, out, font {file, variable}, cut_offset, only, settings_record (the person's row record:setting:compose-thumbnails-from-layout-templates~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>, handed as the record) and settings. The README lists the values each template reads.

output_schema.description: The last line: {"result": {"thumbnails": [paths]}} or {"error": what to change}.

invoke.say: This runs on the person's own computer, from the root of the Workshop checkout. Read the person's settings row (record:setting:compose-thumbnails-from-layout-templates~film~<their film>) from their records and put the record itself in settings_record; do not invent candidates. Write the request with their frames and cut-outs folders, an output folder and their font, pass its path as {request}, then name the thumbnails written or say what the error asks to change. If you cannot run commands, give them these steps.

provenance.source: Ported from a film's thumbnail builder: its layout functions are the templates; its candidate table is the person's settings row
